metadata.name: sanctum
metadata.description: Uroboros Sanctum: rate-limited, delayed, freezable vault for one Solana wallet

instructions.name: approve_queued
docs: Cold key vouches for an item queued while guardians were muted (after a cold unfreeze). It still waits
out the delay and is still voided by a later panic.

instructions.name: cancel_queued
docs: Hot or cold. Closes the queue item (rent back to whoever paid for it). Works on voided items too.

instructions.name: cold_set_rules
docs: Cold key sets any rules, at once. Cancels a pending hot-key proposal.

instructions.name: cold_withdraw_sol
docs: Cold-key withdrawal: skips the queue, never the hourly/daily caps or a freeze.

instructions.name: create
docs: The hot key creates a Sanctum (PDA per hot key + nonce) and funds the SOL vault's rent-exempt minimum.

instructions.name: deposit_sol
docs: Anyone may deposit SOL (a plain transfer to the vault address works too).

instructions.name: deposit_token
docs: Anyone may deposit SPL / Token-2022 tokens; creates the vault's ATA if needed.

instructions.name: execute_queued_sol
docs: Hot or cold, after ready_at, not frozen, not voided by a later panic. Pays in full (the delay replaced the caps).

instructions.name: init_staking
docs: Once, by the program's upgrade authority, right after the token exists. Stores that key as staking admin.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: Only the program's upgrade authority may initialize (blocks a front-run init with a hostile admin).

instructions.name: panic
docs: Hot, cold or any guardian: freeze all outflows for 24h and void everything queued so far.
Guardians: muted for 24h after a cold unfreeze; may only re-panic in the last hour of a running freeze.

instructions.name: propose_rules
docs: Hot key proposes TIGHTER rules; they apply after max(current delay, 3 days).

instructions.name: request_unstake
docs: Starts the cooldown for the whole stake. The node cannot panic from now on; it stays slashable.

instructions.name: set_modes
docs: Cold key: watcher coverage on/off and approval mode. Watchers require approval mode (otherwise every
legitimate queued transfer would be frozen in its final hour).

instructions.name: slash
docs: v1: slashing is decided by the team (admin) key. The slashed tokens are burned.

instructions.name: unfreeze_and_rotate
docs: Cold key: unfreeze and replace the (presumed stolen) hot key in one step, so a thief cannot re-panic.

instructions.name: watcher_panic
docs: A staked, active node freezes a Sanctum that opted in, citing a live, unapproved queue item in its final hour.
Same limits as a guardian: muted 24h after a cold unfreeze, re-panic only in the last hour of a freeze.

instructions.name: withdraw_sol
docs: Hot key. Pays now if inside the hourly + daily room and <= delay_bps of balance; otherwise queues.

instructions.name: withdraw_stake
docs: After the cooldown: everything left goes back to the operator and the node account closes.

instructions.name: withdraw_token
docs: Hot key, tokens. Same rules as `withdraw_sol`; `to` must be a token account of the same mint.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: signer has no standing for this action

errors.name: VoidedByPanic
errors.msg: queued transfer voided by a panic

errors.name: NeedsColdApproval
errors.msg: queued during guardian mute: needs cold approval

errors.name: GuardianMuted
errors.msg: guardians are muted after a cold unfreeze

errors.name: FrozenLastHourOnly
errors.msg: guardians may only re-panic in the last hour of a freeze

errors.name: TightenOnly
errors.msg: hot key may only tighten rules

errors.name: WrongAsset
errors.msg: asset does not match the queue item

errors.name: QueueApproved
errors.msg: queue item is approved by the cold key

errors.name: NotFinalHour
errors.msg: queue item is not in its final hour

types.name: CapState
docs: Per (sanctum, mint) outflow accounting. mint = default pubkey for SOL. All sums are u128 (no truncation).
Daily-cap basis = current balance + capped outflow of the last 24h = (balance 24h ago + deposits since -
queued/other outflows since). A deposit can only raise the allowance by 10% of itself, and deposited funds
are locked under the same caps, so inflating the balance never lets more than 10% of (start + deposits) out.

fields.name: unstake_at
docs: 0 = active; otherwise the time the cooldown ends (node can no longer panic)

fields.name: cap_bps
docs: max outflow per asset per fixed hour, bps of the balance at the hour window's start

fields.name: day_cap_bps
docs: max outflow per asset per rolling 24h, bps of (balance + what left in the last 24h)

fields.name: delay_bps
docs: transfers above this share of the balance are queued

fields.name: delay_secs
docs: seconds a queued transfer waits

fields.name: panic_epoch
docs: bumped by every panic; a queue item is valid only while its epoch equals this

fields.name: watchers_on
docs: cold opt-in: staked watcher nodes may panic on unapproved queue items in their final hour

fields.name: approval_mode
docs: every queued transfer needs cold approval before it can execute (forced on while watchers_on)
